title: UP Lawyers Demand Advocates Protection Act, Breach Multiple Police Barricades During Lucknow Protest | Video

ai.summary: Lawyers in Lucknow breached police barricades during a protest demanding the Advocates Protection Act in Uttar Pradesh, leading to clashes with security personnel as they marched toward the state Assembly.

facts.claim: Hundreds of lawyers took to the streets in Lucknow on Saturday, demanding the immediate implementation of the Advocates Protection Act in Uttar Pradesh
facts.quote: Hundreds of lawyers took to the streets in Lucknow on Saturday, demanding the immediate implementation of the Advocates Protection Act in Uttar Pradesh.

facts.claim: The protest turned tense as demonstrators breached multiple police barricades and pushed their way towards the state Assembly, leading to scuffles with security personnel
facts.quote: The protest turned tense as demonstrators breached multiple police barricades and pushed their way towards the state Assembly, leading to scuffles with security personnel.

facts.claim: Lawyers, who began their march from the district court premises in Kaiserbagh, moved through Parivartan Chowk and Atal Chowk before reaching Hazratganj
facts.quote: Lawyers, who began their march from the district court premises in Kaiserbagh, moved through Parivartan Chowk and Atal Chowk before reaching Hazratganj.

facts.claim: At Hazratganj crossing, the protesters broke through a police barricade and climbed over another in an attempt to move forward
facts.quote: At Hazratganj crossing, the protesters broke through a police barricade and climbed over another in an attempt to move forward.

facts.claim: The protesters subsequently breached barricades erected along the route from Kaiserbagh to Parivartan Chowk, Hazratganj and the Gandhi statue near the GPO
facts.quote: The protesters subsequently breached barricades erected along the route from Kaiserbagh to Parivartan Chowk, Hazratganj and the Gandhi statue near the GPO.

facts.claim: Lawyers from several districts and associations across the state participated in the demonstration
facts.quote: Lawyers from several districts and associations across the state participated in the demonstration.

facts.claim: They argued that an Advocates Protection Act was essential to ensure the safety of lawyers, who face threats and attacks in the course of their professional duties
facts.quote: They argued that an Advocates Protection Act was essential to ensure the safety of lawyers, who face threats and attacks in the course of their professional duties.

ai.background_note: Lawyers in Uttar Pradesh are demanding the Advocates Protection Act to address threats and attacks they face in their professional duties.
